### Observed differences

- In the earlier window, A01 was not observed at all (0 of 200 traces); in the later window it occurs in every trace (200 of 200), exactly once per trace and never repeated, at an early position (median relative position 0.2). [OCC001, POS001]
- In the later window, A01 is placed after A02: A02 → A01 makes up about 54 in 100 of A02's outgoing transitions (previously 0), while the direct A02 → A04 transition falls from about 87 in 100 to about 44 in 100; A04 is now followed by A01 in about 39 in 100 of its outgoing transitions (previously never). [DIR002, DIR004, REL001]
- A01's outgoing transitions in the later window go mainly to A04 (about 46 in 100), A07 (17), A03 (16), A10 (10) and A05 (6) — a mix resembling the former successor profiles of A02 and A04; A01 and A04 co-occur in every trace, with A01 before A04 in about 55 in 100 traces and after it in about 45 in 100, and A02 precedes A01 in all traces. [DIR001, REL001, REL003]
- Downstream activities are reached about one step later than before: A02 → A06 moved from lag 4 (99 in 100) to lag 5 (97 in 100), A02 → A07 from lag 2 (67 in 100) to lag 3 (64 in 100), A02 → A03 and A02 → A10 each shifted about one step later, and from A04 the A04 → A06 distance split between lags 3 and 4 (about 50 in 100 each, previously lag 3 in 89 in 100) and A04 → A07 between lags 1 and 2. [LAG001, LAG002, LAG003, LAG004, LAG005, LAG010, LAG011]
- Several downstream activities now sit later in the trace (mean relative position: A03 0.51 → 0.68, A10 0.46 → 0.68, A04 0.24 → 0.31, A07 0.45 → 0.52). [POS002, POS003, POS005, POS007]
- A09 was observed in 90 of 200 traces (45%) in the earlier window, always as the final event (mean relative position ≈ 1.0) and always directly after A06; in the later window it is not observed at all (0 of 200), and A06 now ends traces (median relative position 1.0; an outgoing transition from A06 appears in only 3 traces). [OCC007, POS004, POS006, DIR006, REL023]
- Participation of the remaining activities moved only by about 2–3 in 100 traces (A03, A06 and A10 45% → 47.5%; A05, A07, A08 and A11 55% → 52.5%); differences of this size arise routinely in random re-splits of an unchanged process (empirical strength about 0.37). [OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, OCC005, OCC006, OCC008, OCC009]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that a new step, A01, was inserted into the early part of the flow. In the later window A01 runs exactly once per trace, always after A02, before A04 in about 55 in 100 traces and after A04 in about 45 in 100; consequently A02 and A04 lost much of their direct transitions into the downstream activities (A02 → A04 from about 87 to 44 in 100 of A02's outgoing transitions), and A03, A06, A07 and A10 are reached about one step later than before. The placement is shown directly by the new transitions into and out of A01, by the co-occurrence and order profiles of A01 with A02 and A04, and by the one-step lag shifts, and the all-or-nothing participation flip (0 of 200 traces to 200 of 200, empirical strength 0.995) is far outside what random re-splits of an unchanged process produce. [OCC001, DIR001, DIR002, DIR004, REL001, REL003, LAG001, LAG003, LAG004, LAG005, LAG010]

Limitations: the evidence cannot rule out that A01 is a re-labelled existing step rather than a genuinely new one, since activity codes are anonymous — although every earlier activity except A09 still appears in the later window, making a simple renaming unlikely — and the insertion point is not single, as A01 sits between A02 and A04 in roughly half of the traces and after A04 in the rest. [OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, OCC005, OCC006, OCC008, OCC009, DIR001, DIR002, REL003]

Other differences: A09, previously the terminal step after A06 in about 45 in 100 traces, is no longer observed in the later window, and traces now end at A06 — a directly evidenced structural change (participation 90 of 200 to 0 of 200; A06 → A09 in all earlier outgoing transitions of A06; A06 now at relative position 1.0), though strictly it shows only that A09 was not observed in the later window; it is separate from the insertion. The small participation shifts of about ±2.5 in 100 traces for A03, A05, A06, A07, A08, A10 and A11 are of the size random re-splits routinely produce and are not treated as changes. [OCC002, OCC003, OCC005, OCC007, POS004, POS006, DIR006, REL023]
